2829-3764-7924.description:
Activate Summoning Station by tapping it, creating a Clue token due to Flitwing.
Activate Arcbound Ravager by sacrificing the Clue.
Summoning Station triggers, untapping it.
Resolve the Arcbound Ravager ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on Arcbound Ravager
Repeat.

6495-7084-7889.description:
Activate Evereth by sacrificing another nonland creature you control.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land.
Resolve the Evereth ability.
Activate Evereth by sacrificing the land.
When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters, Dancing from Dark to Dawn triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Evereth ability.
Repeat.
6495-7084-7889.notes: If you have a way to kill Evereth and {1}{B/R} available, you can do so after putting a significant amount of +1/+1 counters on it to deal damage to each opponent using its second ability.

1981-2415-2921-6273.description:
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing a creature
When the creature dies, Embalmed Ascendant and Havoc Jester trigger.
Resolve the Embalmed Ascendant trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life
Resolve the Havoc Jester trigger, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on them.
Repeat.

997-7084-7893.description:
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing another nonland creature you control.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land.

Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing the land.
When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters, Thranduil triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability.
Repeat.

Scrap Trawler triggers, returning the artifact with mana value 0 from your graveyard to your hand.

2511-3033-6972.description:
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Vengeful Vampire
When Vengeful Vampire dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Vengeful Vampire
When Vengeful Vampire dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
Resolve both Bloodflow Connoisseur abilities from step 1 and 3.
Repeat.
2511-3033-6972.notes: If Vengeful Vampire starts with a +1/+1 counter on it, then you may start the combo from step 3 instead.

3259-4053-7297-7604.notablePrerequisites:
Breath of Fury attached to another creature you control with mana value 3 or less.
You either control another nontoken creature with mana value 3 or less, or have a creature card with mana value 3 or less in your graveyard.
An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
3259-4053-7297-7604.description:
Declare Excava and the creature with Breath of Fury attached as attackers.
Excava triggers, returning up to one creature with mana value 3 or less from your graveyard to the battlefield. It won't enter with a finality counter on it due to Solemnity.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to another creature with mana value 3 or less, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one. 
Repeat each combat phase.
3259-4053-7297-7604.notes: If both creatures used have haste, you can ignore the haste enabler.

4659-5086-5183-6291-6996.easyPrerequisites: Triskelavus has two or more +1/+1 counters on it.
4659-5086-5183-6291-6996.description:
Activate Triskelavus by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, creating two creature tokens.
Activate a Triskelavite token by sacrificing it, dealing 1 damage to any target and causing you to gain life.
The Destined White Mage triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Triskelavus
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing another creature token, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat from step 1.

813-5733-7339.notablePrerequisites: You control a Rogue that does not have summoning sickness and that cannot be blocked by an opponent.
813-5733-7339.description:
Deal combat damage using a Rogue.
Cast Notorious Throng by paying its prowl cost, taking an extra turn.
Cast Go Ninja Go by paying its mana cost, blinking Scholar of the Ages.
When Scholar of the Ages enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Notorious Throng and Go Ninja Go from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat each turn.

851-5742-5743-7178.description:
Activate Iron-Shield Elf by discarding Gilded Assault Cart.
Mary Read and Anne Bonny triggers, creating two tapped Treasure tokens.
Resolve the Iron-Shield Elf ability.
Activate Gilded Assault Cart by sacrificing two Treasures, returning Gilded Assault Cart from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Arcbound Prototype.
When Arcbound Prototype dies, its modular ability and persist ability trigger.
Resolve the modular trigger, putting Arcbound Prototype's +1/+1 counters on another artifact creature.
Resolve the persist trigger, returning Arcbound Prototype from your graveyard to the battlefield. It will not have a -1/-1 counter on it due to its modular ability.
Repeat.

Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
When Sensei's Divining Top enters, Yotian Dissident triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Yotian Dissident.
Repeat.

When Nether Traitor dies, Zahur triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the creature token, adding one mana of any color.
When the creature token dies, Nether Traitor triggers, causing you to pay {B} to return Nether Traitor from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

Activate Gretchen by tapping {2}{G}{U}, causing you to draw a card.
Activate Mind Over Matter by discarding a card, untapping Timeless Lotus.
Repeat.

791-3693-4522-6093.notablePrerequisites:
Quest for Pure Flame has at least four quest counters on it.
You have a way to give Walking Ballista lifelink.
Walking Ballista has at least two +1/+1 counters on it, or your life total is at least 4.
791-3693-4522-6093.description:
Activate Quest for Pure Flame by removing four quest counters from it and sacrificing it, doubling all damage you deal this turn.
Give Walking Ballista lifelink, if needed.
If Walking Ballista has less than two +1/+1 counters on it, activate Unspeakable Symbol by paying 3 life, putting a +1/+1 counter on Walking Ballista.
Activate Walking Ballista's second ability by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, dealing 4 damage to an opponent or a permanent an opponent controls, and causing you to gain 4 life.
Repeat from step 3.

1314-2743-4483.notablePrerequisites:
You have a way to kill Biovisionary.
You have cast your commander from the command zone at least twice this game.
1314-2743-4483.description:
Kill Biovisionary.
When Biovisionary dies, Brenard triggers, creating a token copy of Biovisionary that is a 1/1 Food Golem.
Cast Echo Storm by paying {3}{U}{U}, targeting the Biovisionary token.
Echo Storm triggers, copying it for each time you've cast from the command zone this game, with each copy targeting the Biovisionary token.
Resolve all Echo Storms, creating that  make copies of the Biovisionary token.
At the beginning of your end step, each Biovisionary triggers.
Resolve the first trigger, causing you to win the game.

When the Knight token enters the battlefield, Brimstone Trebuchet triggers, untapping itself.
Repeat.

1537-2341-4906.notablePrerequisites:
Creatures you control can tap to produce at least {3}{R/W}.
Agrus Kos is not your commander.
1537-2341-4906.description:
Activate all mana-producing creatures you control by tapping them, adding at least {3}{R/W}.
Cast Zealous Conscripts by paying {4}{R}.
Zealous Conscripts enters the battlefield, targeting Agrus Kos.
Agrus Kos triggers, holding priority, activate The Peregrine Dynamo by paying {1} and tapping it, copying Agrus Kos' ability.
Resolve the copy of Agrus Kos' ability, causing you to pay {1}{R/W} to copy Zealous Conscripts's ability targeting each other creature you control.
Resolve all copied abilities, untapping each creature you control and giving them haste.
Activate all mana-producing creatures you control by tapping them, adding at least {3}{R/W}.
Repeat from step 4.
